tools.name: find_cat_breed
tools.description: Match a cat description to likely breeds from furriq.com's curated database of 61 breeds. Describe what the cat looks like or how it behaves (coat pattern, body shape, ears, temperament) and get the top candidates with the specific markers that matched. Deterministic — no AI guessing.

tools.name: get_breed
tools.description: Get the full profile of one cat breed from furriq.com: physical identification markers, temperament traits, size/weight/lifespan/origin, health notes, and links to similar breeds.

tools.name: compare_breeds
tools.description: Compare two cat breeds side by side (identification markers, temperament, care) and, when the breeds are commonly confused, return furriq.com's "how to tell them apart" guidance.

tools.name: list_breeds
tools.description: List all 61 cat breeds in the furriq.com database with size, origin, and category.

tools.name: analyze_cat_photo
tools.description: Analyze a cat photo with AI vision and estimate the most likely breeds, with honest uncertainty. Provide a public image URL (or a data: URL). Limited to 10 analyses per day; a lighter deterministic alternative is find_cat_breed with a text description. For a full report, https://www.furriq.com/ident
